verdicts.PASS_REPRODUCED: All exact-pin, command, scope and execution-evidence checks pass and overall_status=PASS.
verdicts.FAIL_REPRODUCTION: Receipt is authentic in shape/scope but reports overall_status=FAIL or a required native command FAIL.
verdicts.HOLD_NO_RECEIPT: No admissible receipt has been provided for the source family.
verdicts.HOLD_INCOMPLETE: Receipt is structurally admissible but required execution results are SKIP/incomplete.
verdicts.REJECT_INVALID_RECEIPT: Identity, pin, disclosure, mutation, authority, scope, command coverage, or result consistency check fails.
verdicts.REJECT_NON_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE: Receipt is synthetic/schema-test/source-reported evidence rather than a direct runner execution receipt.
verdicts.REJECT_CONFLICT: A second receipt conflicts with an already admitted receipt for the same source family and exact source commit.
